name: SBC Exports Limited
summary: SBC Exports Limited manufactures and sells hosiery fabrics and garments in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Garments Manufacturing; Information Technology Services; and Travel and Tour Operations. It offers T-shirts, denims, sweatshirts, trousers, jackets, leggings, etc. under the SBC DESIGN+, F-ROUTE, IEDEE, FEMAS FASHIONS, FEMAS LINGERIE'S, and FEMAS JEANS brands for ladies, men, and kids; and wool and silk carpets. The company also provides e-governance, web and software development, scanning and digitization, manpower supply, and system integration services, as well as IT solutions.
